fullDesc: On September 6, 1995 Cal Ripken Jr. of the Baltimore Orioles played his 2,131st consecutive game, breaking Lou Gehrig's record of 2,130 that had stood for 56 years. His streak ended at 2,632 games in 1998.
realFacts: The game was stopped for a long ovation
He later entered the Hall of Fame
Gehrig's streak had been seen as unbreakable
Ripken chose to sit out in 1998 himself
